proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the stack satisfies (RS*) by the spaces-RS-star lemma so the artin properties-lift lemma applies and produces T_x(k), Inf_x(k), agreeing with the finite-type variant by the compare-deformation-spaces remark; the deformation-theory lemma gives T_x(k) = Ext^1(NL_{X/k}, O_X) and Inf_x(k) = Ext^0(NL_{X/k}, O_X); the cotangent complex has coherent cohomology concentrated in degrees 0, -1 (netherlander lemma + Noetherian), and the ext-finite lemma gives finite dimensionality (source lines 3822-3852)
